Items:
- G41 trialwise() with term-specific onsets, subset, phase, parent and id (pinned trialwise() takes no positional variable and accepts only basis, durations, lag, nbasis, add_sum, label, scaling, normalize — FormulaParser.scala:497 — and uses the formula's default onsets for every event). Single-trial ids must be enumerated per run and labelled with run and condition (invariant I5; the mock unioned ids across runs and mislabelled filtered trials as "no events").
- LSA vs LSS selection: LSS-1 = target trial vs all other trials of the term collapsed into one regressor; the studio shows a selectable target trial's design (contrastStats/analyse on that design). Identifiability check on every change (see SF3 note).
- G16/G23/G27/G40 typed baseline and confounds printable in model text: DCT cutoff, intercept policy, motion 6/12/24, aCompCor k, WM/CSF, global signal, FD censoring as spike regressors with threshold, neighbours, minimum segment and run-exclusion threshold (regenMotion 499 shows the mock's FD and spikes).
- G17 noise model AR(1)/AR(2) prewhitening (relates to PHRF-CMP S2 bd-01M3VZTHVNNK5TNS5KHX76PM0E; diagnostics under a nominal noise model is G36).
- G19/G37 multi-run contrast policy: fixed effects over estimable runs (report count), concatenated runs, run-specific σ.
Acceptance: each item parses, builds and round-trips through SF4; LSS parity with the PHRF-CMP S11 fixtures where applicable; censoring and confound df match the studio's accounting (e.g. +8 columns: df 217 → 209 in gamble).

Evidence bundle (durable, not in Git): /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro-fixtures/model-studio-hillclimb-20261002 — start with README.md there (layout, reference-implementation line map, how to run the audits, verified numbers).
Reference implementation: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro-fixtures/model-studio-hillclimb-20261002/out/m7b/index.html (single inline script; line numbers below refer to it). It is a design mock on synthetic data: use it as a behavioural specification and a source of fixtures, not as validated science.
Design spec and consumer plan (PLS Neuro, branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb at d47c988, worktree /private/tmp/plsneuro-model-studio): docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md (invariants I1–I13 in section 3), docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-native-plan.md. Grammar ledger with ScalaFIM file refs: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro-fixtures/model-studio-hillclimb-20261002/GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md.
Example studies for fixtures: STUDIES (line 424): block localizer (TR 2, N 180), mixed gambles (N 240; gain, loss, gain×loss), delayed match-to-sample (N 210; sample/delay/probe/errors phases; accuracy), stop signal (N 200; FIR 10×2 s; rt n/a for successful stops, ssd n/a for go), category × attention (N 240; 12 cells × canonical+temporal+dispersion; 24 motion). Runs use seeds 11 and 29; motion from motionSet (418); FD/censoring and confounds in regenMotion (499).
